title: EU AI Act Article 14 — Human oversight
description: The human-oversight requirement for high-risk AI systems within the EU AI Act. Paraphrase pending verification against the primary EUR-Lex text — hence 'Community' confidence.
control_text: High-risk AI systems must be designed to allow effective human oversight, including the ability for a human overseer to understand the system's capabilities and limitations, monitor its operation, correctly interpret its output, decide not to use it in a given situation, and intervene in or interrupt its operation.

citations.title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act)
citations.publisher: EUR-Lex / Official Journal of the European Union

relationships.reason: Satisfying this control requires a documented safety case demonstrating the oversight mechanism actually works.
